evidence.note: Dedicated verification task explicitly scoping the grader-faithful checks: file <32MB, load_model_for_verification works, forward contract satisfied, and OOD probe (logits depend on position).
Multiple inline python -c tests during build to sanity-check forward/quant behavior before committing to a long training run.
After first run: backs up checkpoint, lists .ptz size, reloads checkpoint via python -c, and runs a size test — independent re-load + size confirmation.
After final quant: dedicated python -c verification passes (load through verification path + forward + size) run as a gate before marking the verify task complete (152).
Tracked best_bpb ~0.9737 against the 0.983 threshold, showing awareness of proxy margin to the target.

reasoning: The agent planned and executed grader-faithful verification through the exact entry point (load_model_for_verification), confirmed the <32MB size cap, tested the forward contract, and probed position-dependence (OOD probe), re-running these checks after both training runs and reasoning about margin to the 0.983 threshold — matching the level-8 anchor. It falls short of 10 because the checks were run ad hoc per iteration rather than as a single standalone reusable harness gate, and the summaries do not evidence explicit loss==cross_entropy or int8 round-trip assertions; it clearly exceeds level 5, which only requires independent reload + size + local bpb.
